items.title: 15.6 Thin films (patli tahon) mein interference (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation, paragraph for paragraph with the English (book) lesson.

blocks.text: Pani par tairti tel ki patli layer (tah) ya sabun ke bulbule se roshni reflect ho (takra kar wapas aaye) to aksar rangeen roshan bands nazar aate hain. Yeh interference ka result hain. Aisi thin films (patli tahon) ki oopar wali aur neeche wali dono surfaces se roshni ki waves reflect hoti hain. In do reflected waves ke raste ki lambai alag hai, aur in ka constructive interference alag alag wavelengths ke liye alag jagahon par hota hai. Fig. 15.11 yeh situation dikhati hai. Thickness (motai) t wali thin film ki oopar wali surface par parne wali roshni ka kuch hissa oopar hi se reflect ho jata hai (rasta abc). Jo roshni oopar ki surface se andar chali jati hai (transmit hoti hai) us ka kuch hissa neeche wali surface se reflect hota hai (rasta abdef). Dono reflected waves aankh ke retina par point P par milti hain. Un ke phase ke talluq ke mutabiq constructive ya destructive interference ho sakta hai. Har rang ki wavelength alag hai, is liye kisi rang ke liye interference constructive aur kisi ke liye destructive ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Index n aur thickness t ki patli film aik surface par, oopar hawa. Ray a film par point b par pohanchti hai. Kuch hissa bc ke raste aankh ki taraf reflect hota hai; kuch film mein andar ja kar neeche ki surface par d par reflect hota hai, e par oopar aa kar ef ke raste aankh ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.11: Thin film (patli tah) (kitab ki Figure 15.11 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Isi liye thin film mein rangeen patterns nazar aate hain, jaise Fig. 15.12 (kitab mein photo) mein sabun ke solution (sabun ghule pani) ki patli films jo bulbule ki deewaren banati hain. Isi tarah pani par tairti tel ki patli film bhi aisa hi pattern dikhati hai. Rangeen patterns ki uljhi hui shaklein film ki thickness mein farq ki wajah se banti hain.

Ab aik aasan situation dekhein: monochromatic (sirf aik rang yani aik wavelength wali) roshni do taqreeban parallel surfaces se, taqreeban seedhi (normal incidence, surface par 90° ke qareeb) par kar, reflect hoti hai. Fig. 15.13 mein glass (sheeshe) ki do plates hain jin ke darmiyan hawa ki patli wedge (triangle jaisi patli tah) ya film hai. Hum hawa ki wedge ke saath lagi do surfaces se reflect hone wali do waves ka interference dekhte hain. (Oopar wali plate ki oopar ki surface aur neeche wali plate ki neeche ki surface se bhi reflection hota hai, lekin baat saada rakhne ke liye unhein shamil nahi karte.) Situation bilkul Fig. 15.11 jaisi hai, farq sirf yeh hai ke wedge ki thickness har jagah barabar nahi. Har point par dono waves ka path difference hawa ki wedge ki thickness t ka dugna, yani 2t hai. Jahan 2t wavelength ka poora number guna ho wahan constructive interference aur roshan hissa hona chahiye; jahan half-integer (aadhe wala number) guna ho wahan destructive interference aur andhera hissa hona chahiye. Jahan plates aapas mein chhooti hain wahan path difference taqreeban zero hai, is liye wahan roshan hissa hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Fig. 15.13(a)' likhti hai. Muqabla barabar thickness wali thin film (Fig. 15.11) se hai; Fig. 15.13 ka koi hissa (a) nahi hai.

blocks.alt: Glass ki do plates left sire par chhooti hain; l faasle par h unchai ka spacer oopar wali plate ko utha kar hawa ki patli wedge banata hai. Contact se x faasle par hawa ki film ki thickness t hai. Wahan ray parti hai aur hawa ki film ke oopar aur neeche se reflect hui do rays aankh tak jati hain. Labels: Air, Glass.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.13: Thin film (hawa ki wedge) (kitab ki Figure 15.13 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.text: Lekin experiment karne par roshan aur andhere fringes to nazar aate hain, magar ulte! Jis line par plates chhooti hain wahan andhera fringe milta hai, roshan nahi. Is se pata chalta hai ke dono reflected waves mein se aik ne reflection ke waqt half cycle (aadhe cycle, 180°) ka phase shift liya hai. Is soorat mein contact wali line par reflect hone wali dono waves, raste ki lambai barabar hone ke bawajood, aadha cycle out of phase hoti hain aur aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain.
Asal mein yeh phase shift Maxwell ki equations aur roshni ki electromagnetic nature se pehle hi bataya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Half cycle ka phase shift tab hota hai jab roshni zyada refractive index wale medium se reflect ho (kam index se aa kar zyada index wali surface se takraye). Hawa ki wedge mein yeh neeche wali glass surface (hawa se glass) par hota hai, is liye contact ki line andheri hai.

blocks.prompt: Interference ke rang sabun ke bulbule par kyun nazar aate hain lekin khirki ke sheeshe par kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Sabun ki film sirf roshni ki chand wavelengths jitni moti hai, is liye dono reflections ka chhota path difference har rang ke liye alag result deta hai. Khirki ka sheesha hazaron wavelengths mota hai; path difference bohat bara hai aur thickness ya angle ke zara se farq se har rang ke roshan aur andhere hisse aapas mein mil jate hain, is liye koi rang nazar nahi aata.

items: Thin film: oopar aur neeche ki surface se reflect hone wali waves interference karti hain; rang film ki thickness par depend karte hain.
Hawa ki wedge: path difference 2t; 2t poori wavelengths = roshan, aadhi = andhera (agar phase shift na ho).
Experiment mein contact ki line andheri: aik reflection par half cycle ka phase shift.
